GENERAL — MOCK EXAM #7
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: General
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which option best shows correct understanding of Spreadsheet? (1 mark)
   A. Copy a rumour about Spreadsheet without checking.
   B. Treat Spreadsheet as empty slogans with no facts.
   C. Use Spreadsheet to shame classmates.
   D. Apply Spreadsheet with accurate facts in a Kenyan home, school, or community situation.

2. Which option best shows correct understanding of Database Management System? (1 mark)
   A. Copy a rumour about Database Management System without checking.
   B. Use Database Management System to shame classmates.
   C. Apply Database Management System with accurate facts in a Kenyan home, school, or community situation.
   D. Treat Database Management System as empty slogans with no facts.

3. Which option best shows correct understanding of Digital Citizenship? (1 mark)
   A. Use Digital Citizenship to shame classmates.
   B. Apply Digital Citizenship with accurate facts in a Kenyan home, school, or community situation.
   C. Copy a rumour about Digital Citizenship without checking.
   D. Treat Digital Citizenship as empty slogans with no facts.

4. Which option best shows correct understanding of Impact of ICT on society? (1 mark)
   A. Copy a rumour about Impact of ICT on society without checking.
   B. Apply Impact of ICT on society with accurate facts in a Kenyan home, school, or community situation.
   C. Use Impact of ICT on society to shame classmates.
   D. Treat Impact of ICT on society as empty slogans with no facts.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
5. In three clear sentences, explain Spreadsheet and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

6. In three clear sentences, explain Database Management System and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

7. In three clear sentences, explain Impact of ICT on society and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

11. In three clear sentences, explain Impact of ICT on society and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
